sources.title: Attention Mechanism in ML - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: Attention is a mechanism used within architectures like encoder-decoder models to improve how information is processed. It works alongside components such as the encoder and decoder by helping the model focus on the most relevant parts of the input.
